source_audit.license: Dataset metadata license field is null; use NYC Open Data / NYC.gov terms, cite LPC attribution, and store factual metadata plus source URLs unless terms are reviewed for broader redistribution.
source_audit.coverage_years: Permit records include historical rows; this extraction used issue_date 2008-2026 and selected current official API rows accessed 2026-05-19.

source_audit.geographic_scope: New York City landmark sites and historic districts, with address/block/lot, borough, community board, and latitude/longitude fields when geocoded.
source_audit.date_fields: issue_date used as observed administrative action date; received_date and expiration_date retained only as source context, not event dates.
source_audit.required_caveats: Permit issuance is not construction completion, restoration completion, or proof of physical change. Work types may be applicant/LPC metadata summaries. Coordinates are geocoded points, not boundaries or approved-work geometry.
source_audit.duplicate_check: Manual corpus checked by exact source_record_id, source_url, and generated title for NYC events in architecture_milestones_2008_2026.json.
